name.km: បបរផ្អែមពោត
name.en: Sweet Coconut Soup with Sweet Corn

description: A warm Khmer sweet soup of sweet corn in pandan-scented coconut milk.
descriptionKm: បបរផ្អែមពោត ក្នុងទឹកដូងស្លឹកតើយ។

ingredients.notesKm: ស្ម័គ្រ សម្រាប់រាងក្រាស់

instructions.text: Simmer the sweet corn in water with pandan until soft.
instructions.textKm: ដាំ ពោត ក្នុងទឹកជាមួយស្លឹកតើយរហូតទន់។

instructions.text: Add palm sugar and a pinch of salt; stir until dissolved.
instructions.textKm: បន្ថែមស្ករត្នោត និងអំបិលបន្តិច; កូររហូតស្កររលាយ។

instructions.text: Pour in the coconut milk and warm through gently without hard-boiling.
instructions.tip: Boiling can split the coconut milk — keep it at a gentle simmer.
instructions.textKm: ស្នូរទឹកដូងចូល កម្ដៅថ្នមៗ កុំឱ្យដាំខ្លាំង។

instructions.text: Serve warm or over ice as a sweet dessert soup (bong-aem).
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគក្ដៅ ឬ លើទឹកកកជាបបរផ្អែម (បង្អែម)។
